description: You are a post-production coordinator at an animation studio. A client has requested the studio's walk cycle animation delivered as a single video file rather than an image sequence. The animation is at /home/ga/OpenToonz/samples/dwanko_run.tnz. Export the complete animation as a video file to /home/ga/OpenToonz/output/video_export/. The client requires a standard video format (MP4, MOV, or AVI). The output video must be a valid playable video containing the full walk cycle animation.
